chaining: unlimited Shared clusters per organization turns a 1 GB per-cluster cap into an N-times-1 GB allowance if the schema can be partitioned, which no other free tier allows.

limits.value: 1 GB of compressed data per cluster fails first, but 10 tables per database is the constraint a schema hits sooner; unlimited clusters per organization is the workaround and it partitions the data by hand.

notes: CREATE DATABASE and DROP DATABASE are disabled on Shared clusters, so a schema change means terminating and rebuilding the cluster. Shared clusters are reachable from anywhere with no firewall configuration and are stated as not for production. The pricing page no longer prints a free plan card, so the docs are the only current source.
